meta.timerNote: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 on ANGLE Metal returns non-zero, non-disjoint results that scale with GPU work, but they are spans of 2-2.5x the GPU-bound frame interval (e.g. Ultra downtown idle: query 8.4 ms at a 3.5 ms frame; one injected fullscreen pass: query 20.7 ms at an 8.1 ms frame), so not GPU busy time. gpuMs is null where the per-cell check fails (query median > 1.1x frame median); frameMs is the GPU-bound measure (trace.waitMsPerFrame shows the main thread waiting on the GPU side).
